This is a '''list of [[surface (mathematics)|surface]]s''' in mathematics. They are divided into [[minimal surfaces]], [[ruled surfaces]], [[non-orientable surfaces]], [[quadrics]], [[pseudospherical surfaces]], [[algebraic surfaces]], and other types of surfaces.
